description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git submodule reference behaviors and the use of alternates in repositories and submodules. It sets up various repositories, adds submodules, and performs update and clone operations to verify correct handling of alternate object directories against reference repositories.

methods.name: test_alternate_is_used
methods.description: Checks if the specified alternates file is used in the repository or submodule, indicating that the alternate object directory is correctly configured.
